independent_host_policies.delay_authority: Empirical fixed input-to-pulse alignment, not a recovered coroutine constant. Native first/second raw-to-pulse delays differed.12/.19s; begin-to-pulse differed.10/.16s. Identical four-pulse impulse strength with different pre-pulse COM momentum explains much of native cross-hop height variation.
independent_host_policies.budget_authority: Finite reduced-host reaction budgets.20000 removes prior contact output_limit failures on measured replay without changing joint energy guards; neither budget is asserted to be a native setting.
independent_host_policies.contact_policy: Positive anticipated gaps can limit future impact velocity but cannot qualify support, launch a hop or settle a trick.
independent_host_policies.joint_solver: Bounded implicit coupled six-axis drives plus a dissipative radial soft stop. Equal/opposite internal reactions and exact lever-arm torques; explicit source acceleration-drive reference retains the original10/80kg drive gain conversion after folding followers.
independent_host_policies.radial_stop: Native LimitedXYZ is approximated by an independent finite unilateral soft stop. V2 opts into separate projected lower/upper implicit rows: inside bounds, boundary-reaching velocity gives continuous zero-force entry; outside, the original spring ERP and damping are retained. Sign projection prevents attraction while escaping. Whole-wrench caps and original energy admission are unchanged; no recorded body-state injection or pose repair.
independent_host_policies.playback: Command clocks start on accepted selection/input events. Enter endpoints hold until actual recovery; recover phases start on release. A trick command replaces the overlapping quickhop command instead of adding its base animation twice.
independent_host_policies.presentation: Joint-driven chassis pitch/roll suppresses independent catalog presentation tilt. Bar/tail articulation and gameplay trick state remain available; physical wheel queries ignore authored trick tilt.
independent_host_policies.skeletal_mapping: Spring is not an ancestor of the observed AnimatedSkeleton. Physics-to-proximal-bone retargeting is independent; full55bone observed posture tracks are separately available.
independent_host_policies.wheel_geometry_limit: Legacy rigid-wheel contact centers remain in this model. V3.3 confirms distinct native body position, collider center, wheel COM and nominal base/contact transforms; those separately articulated geometry/query roles are not silently equated or yet reproduced by the two-body host.
independent_host_policies.stabilization: Exact fresh neutral-air Spring PID uses.2 pitch control and flip attenuation. Native manual setpoint/direct-torque branches enable ground pitch on Spring and Chassis only while manual input is active. Ordinary Chassis PID remains disabled because its animator helper/control-bone channels are unavailable; native Chassis PID is not claimed disabled.
independent_host_policies.angular_speed_limits: Reference host applies observed15rad/s role limits by dissipative angular-momentum scaling before orientation integration. Native-engine adapters configure these body properties separately from force outputs. Source SpinSystem12rad/s user control limit remains separate.
independent_host_policies.net_wrench_feasibility: Contact response uses one common fraction across wheel constraints. When internal suspension reaction alone exceeds the net chassis cap, the solver intersects actual feasible force/torque/rotor intervals so an opposing contact can cancel it. Caps remain85kN/20kNm; no independent axis clipping.
independent_host_policies.rotation_judging: Canonical separately simulated Spring orientation supplies rider spin/flip tracking. The measured selected-rig approach COM velocity is latched at accepted hop/flight and held through settled landing, so bike articulation/contact recoil cannot redefine the approach heading. Actual chassis support, up/closing quality, completion/catch and angle tolerances remain required.
independent_host_policies.manual_modes: Explicit configurable source Manual mode for both directions. Live Nosey Manual mode is observed; moving Manny mode is an inference selected from the two recovered modes, rather than a recovered runtime setting. Auto angle-PID mode remains available by clearing manny_direct_torque/nosey_direct_torque.
independent_host_policies.manual_pitch_duplication: V2 disables the inherited independent manual pitch target and removes its ground pitch spring/damper only during active manual/nose input, so recovered external pitch actuation is not opposed by duplicate independent assistance. Supported roll, tire impulses and caps remain unchanged; legacy/v1 defaults retain their historical behavior.
independent_host_policies.manual_lifecycle: Manual setpoint/direct torque clear on input cancellation and body/device identity changes. Input contacts are exported exactly from the pre-integration query, separately from the reference host post-integration body.
independent_host_policies.angular_damping: Optional use_air_angular_drag selects observed2.75 on both roles only without actual strict grounded support. Ground role drag1 remains unchanged; native transient grounded2.75/5 branches are not yet reproduced. Damping torque is already included once in returned role wrenches; hosts must not apply it twice.
independent_host_policies.swept_plane_normals: Opt-in verified static-plane normal-only rows when a current CLEAR query gap lies above the ordinary.09m skin and at most.25m, and the exact current pre-contact prediction crosses that plane within one fixed step. Requires an accepted consecutive step, active controls, exact prediction/geometry identity and no hop reservation. Rows participate in the original alternating wheel solve and shared net budgets; they grant no friction, support, balance, hop or trick-landing qualification. Defaults/observedv1 remain off.
independent_host_policies.coupling_numerics: 64 Picard evaluations followed only when needed by at most12 safeguarded six-dimensional Newton updates, each with6 finite-difference columns (opposite-side retry if rejected) and12 true-residual backtracking trials. All trials restore the same Movement baseline; PID/actuation clocks step once. Final applied reaction is an energy-admitted suspension result independently checked at the exact applied point against the same.05N/Nm residual. CoupledOutput.coupling_iterations counts all map evaluations, including probes; CoupledSettings coupling_iterations is only the Picard budget.
independent_host_policies.flick_input_lifecycle: Observed flick detectors are opt-in/defaultoff; v2enables both. Host focus/menu/device/body/context cancellation clears pending gestures and applies the source sign-only RequireZeroOut predicate. R3 supersedes a same-frame flick and clears pending gesture states. These ownership/R3 lifecycle choices are stronger host policy, not claimed native setter behavior.
independent_host_policies.flick_physical_actuation: Fullnegative source Ollie preload starts ID83 ENTER and holds its endpoint until release. An accepted Ollie following this preload uses measured TRANSITION; neutral cancellation uses independently captured RECOVER. Each phase is neutral-rebased; transition/recovery starts at the previous applied command with a position/quaternion boundary offset fading to0 by its measured endpoint. This is independent command retargeting, not body-state injection or a native interpolation claim. Source gains/inertias/limits remain commands; caps/energy guards are unchanged.
independent_host_policies.flick_amplitude_and_Nollie_limit: ID83commands are observed only for full-1→+1 and an independent fullnegative→neutral cancellation. Other qualifying amplitudes/partial-Manny-assisted Ollies and Nollies retain explicit generic quickhop command playback; Nollie is not mirrored from ID83. Public HopKind lets a host supply appropriate commands. Source nominal4.5 uses normalizedstrength4.5/6.4; optional no-peg wheel-support policy applies Nollie eligibility/.95 factor.
independent_host_policies.accepted_hop_ownership: Output.hop_request_accepted marks the actual new reserved hop. Raw Actions.hop_pressed/hop_kind can report a gesture denied while a prior hop is pending. Command tracks start only for accepted requests; a rapid opposite gesture orR3 cannot restart the admitted release or duplicate its four impulses.
